source: This is a handbook about the computation inside one Transformer block and how blocks are stacked. It touches kernels, distributed execution, activation checkpointing, and serving only where they clarify block behavior. Those systems topics deserve separate treatment. Notation used throughout
zh: 这是一本关于 Transformer 块内部计算以及块如何堆叠的手册。它涉及内核、分布式执行、激活检查点，并且仅在澄清块行为的地方提供服务。这些系统主题值得单独处理。全文使用的符号
